newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli jets strike in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli jets strike in south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli war planes raided suspected guerrilla targets in south Lebanon on Friday, hours after one Israeli soldier was killed in guerrilla shelling, security sources said.
The sources said two jets fired two rockets into the Habboush river area just north of a border zone which Israel occupies in south Lebanon. There was no immediate word on casualties.

The air attack came hours after one Israeli soldier was killed and two others were wounded when guerrillas fired mortar bombs at the Dabsheh post on the edge of the Israeli-held zone and facing Habboush.

Two guerrillas were killed on Thursday night when Israeli helicopters and artillery gunners fired at a group of fighters trying to infiltrate the zone, sources with the Israeli-backed South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia said.

In Beirut, the pro-Iranian Hizbollah claimed responsibility for the assault on Dabsheh. Hizbollah (Party of God) is fighting to oust some 1,000 Israeli troops and 3,000 SLA militiamen from the south Lebanon zone set up to stop raids on northern Israel.
